_readme: 卡片上要显示的「站名 + 一行小字介绍」，中英各一份。key = 子站点目录名。
build-index.py 每次运行都会先自动从子站点的 <title> / <meta name="description"> 推一遍，
推不出来、或者推得不好看的，就用这份手写覆盖。所以这里不必写全，只写要纠正的那些。
字段：nameZh / nameEn / descZh / descEn —— 缺哪个就哪个走自动推导。

acute-angle-2.0.descZh: 预约制理发店，每一单从约定的时间开始。
acute-angle-2.0.descEn: Appointment-only barber shop — your slot starts when it says it does.

chenguang-watch.descZh: 三十余年老店：机械表保养、古董表修复、换电池换表带。
chenguang-watch.descEn: Thirty years of watch repair — servicing, vintage restoration, batteries, straps.

hongda-auto-repair-2.0.descZh: 价目表与电话预约，周一至周六 8:30–18:30。
hongda-auto-repair-2.0.descEn: Price list and phone booking. Mon–Sat 8:30–18:30, parking in the yard.

laochen-noodles.descZh: 三十年老店，招牌红烧牛肉面，牛肉凌晨四点现卤。
laochen-noodles.descEn: A thirty-year noodle shop — braised beef noodles, meat braised at 4 a.m.

maimang-site-2.0.descZh: 藏在巷子深处的梦境工坊，无糖无油软欧包。
maimang-site-2.0.descEn: A bakery workshop down a winding alley — sourdough, bagels, no sugar added.

shihua 2.0.descZh: 杭州街坊的手作花店，一枝一枝挑，一束一束包。
shihua 2.0.descEn: A neighbourhood flower shop in Hangzhou — stems picked and wrapped one by one.

teapot-artisan.descZh: 手作茶壶，一次十来件，面向海外茶客与藏家。
teapot-artisan.descEn: Handmade teapots, a dozen at a time, for overseas tea buyers and collectors.

tongguan-lvxin.descZh: 祖安呼吸安全站：呼吸器维修、滤芯定制、氧气囊租赁。
tongguan-lvxin.descEn: Respirator repair, custom filter cartridges, oxygen bladder rental. Same day.

tutuhuahua 2.0.descZh: 一间儿童美术教室，转动环廊看孩子们的画。
tutuhuahua 2.0.descEn: A children's art studio — spin the ring to see what they drew.

vinyl-store-site.descZh: 二手唱片店库存自助查询：有没有货、什么版本、多少钱。
vinyl-store-site.descEn: Self-serve inventory for a second-hand record shop, refreshed every Sunday.

void-codex.descZh: 皮尔特沃夫的深夜书店，文学与艺术书 24 小时亮灯。
void-codex.descEn: A late-night bookshop on Hextech Avenue — literature and art, lights on 24h.

yuguang-photo.descZh: 海边小城的婚礼跟拍与家庭纪实，自然光、不摆拍。
yuguang-photo.descEn: Wedding and family documentary in a seaside town — natural light, no posing.
